organization.name: Datun
organization.description: Dentist-backed dental guidance for India: describe any tooth problem, get an assessment plus a report you keep, and book a verified clinic in your language.

summary: Datun helps anyone in India with a dental worry, at any hour, in any language. It gives a dentist-backed assessment and a report you keep, then routes you to a verified clinic when you need one. Datun guides and supports your dentist; it never replaces one and does not perform procedures itself.
audiences: Patients with a dental problem or question
NRIs and international patients considering treatment in India
capabilities: Explain common dental problems (toothache, sensitivity, bleeding gums, cavities, bad breath, broken tooth, wisdom tooth, dental emergency) in calm, plain language
Explain common dental procedures (implant, aligners, braces, root canal, crown, whitening, extraction, scaling, filling): what each is, when it is needed, and what to expect
Provide a dentist-backed assessment and a report the patient keeps
Route patients to primary-source-verified dental clinics near them
Answer dental questions in Hindi and English

entryPoints.name: Homepage
entryPoints.description: Patient homepage: how Datun works, common problems and procedures, verified dentists, patient reviews, and FAQs.

policies.honesty: No fabricated statistics, counts, or ratings. Patient reviews shown on the site are real and consented.
policies.privacy: DPDP 2023 compliant: patient data is encrypted, consent-logged, deletable at any time, and never sold.
policies.medicalScope: A remote assessment cannot fully replace an in-person dental exam. Datun states clearly when a patient should see a dentist in person and when care is urgent.
policies.noDarkPatterns: No false urgency, no pre-ticked consent, no fake counts or timers.
